scripts.build: npm run build -w @email-client/shared && npm run build -w @email-client/api && npm run build -w @email-client/web && npm run build -w @email-client/desktop
scripts.dev: concurrently -k -n api,web -c green,cyan "npm run dev -w @email-client/api" "npm run dev -w @email-client/web"
scripts.dev:desktop: npm run build -w @email-client/shared && concurrently -k -n api,web,desktop -c green,cyan,yellow "npm run dev -w @email-client/api" "npm run dev -w @email-client/web" "npm run dev -w @email-client/desktop"
scripts.start:fresh: npm run build && npm run start:built
scripts.test: npm run test -w @email-client/api && npm run test -w @email-client/web
scripts.test:run: npm run test:run -w @email-client/api && npm run test:run -w @email-client/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @email-client/shared && npm run typecheck -w @email-client/api && npm run build -w @email-client/api && npm run typecheck -w @email-client/web && npm run typecheck -w @email-client/desktop
